FLUX：使用 GGUF、LoRA 和升级的简单而多功能的工作流程
该工作流程结合了先进的组件来生成高质量的输出。它基于 GGUF UNET 和 CLIP 模型的 FLUX 设置构建，集成了用于微调控制的强大 LoRA 加载器，以及用于增强细节的强大 4 倍放大器。非常适合寻求简单性和灵活性而不影响质量的创作者。虽然原始工作流程的创建者未知，但 LoRA 的添加增强了其功能，使其成为实现令人惊叹的结果的首选工具。

o.en:
FLUX: Simple and Versatile Workflow with GGUF, LoRA, and Upscaling
This workflow combines advanced components for generating high-quality outputs. Built on the FLUX setup with GGUF UNET and CLIP models, it integrates a powerful LoRA loader for fine-tuned control, alongside a robust 4x upscaler to enhance details. Perfect for creators seeking simplicity and flexibility without compromising quality. While the original workflow's creator is unknown, the addition of LoRA enhances its functionality, making it a go-to tool for stunning results.
